title: quick halal saudi-arabian beef stir-fry
description: a quick and delicious stir-fry dish inspired by saudi-arabian cuisine, using halal-friendly ingredients and a single vessel for easy cleanup.
instructions: heat ghee or oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
add beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
remove beef from skillet and set aside.
add onion and garlic to skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
add cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper to skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add beef back to skillet and stir to combine with spice mixture.
dissolve beef stock cubes in 200ml water and add to skillet.
bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until sauce has thickened.
stir in creme fraiche or plain yogurt and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
serve hot over rice or with flatbread, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
